q2_gaps: A capitalized NAMED calendrical point / festival ('Mid-summer') filling a Time slot: the Time section says a 'deictic or named' time stays a bare symbol, while Names and casing says every proper noun — a named event included — gets exactly one Name fact and 'neither part is optional'; the instruction set never says which governs, so whether (Name mid_summer "Mid-summer") is required alongside the bare Time filler is undetermined.

Support / light verb taking an event-noun object ('holds a feast'): the light-verb rule names only 'occurred / happened / took place' (event-noun as subject), so it does not say whether a support verb with an agent reifies its own event with the event-noun as a role filler, or whether the event-noun witness is itself the eventuality carrying the time atoms.
notes: Theme vs Patient for the held feast is a genuine borderline (holding arguably brings the occurrence into existence), and the instruction set's explicit 'when the test is unclear, default to Theme' covers the choice made. During is used only for the surface word 'during', with both sides reified, and no Every atom is invented since no periodic wording is present.
